## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-compare`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-compare -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `pointers.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `pointers.jsonl`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-compare at revision `f71f4599352a958e9a5e436f033941798440249a`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC compare

Compare door. Prints the living board only. No second scoreboard.

Council OS: https://councilof.ai/os
Council Space: https://councilof.ai/gspc-arena

Measurement, not certification. Empty slots are not for sale. No scores on this card.

Jail is a measured floor, not a 16th pane.

**Bank.** Frozen split. Live `n` is the matching axis on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`, not a Hub score. **Not a certificate.** Art 50 (EUR-Lex): 2 August 2026 live; marking grace 2 December 2026. Jail is a measured floor, not a 16th pane.

## What is in this repository

| file | bytes | rows | what |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `README.md` | 2000 |  | card |
| `eval.yaml` | 508 |  | config |
| `manifest.jsonl` | | 3 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |
| `pointers.jsonl` | | 7 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |

`manifest.jsonl` is derived from this repository's own file tree at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z; it lists every file with its
size, its blob hash and a direct URL, so an agent can enumerate the repo without cloning it.
